hypothesis: Increasing P0 causal diversity in accepted Train from 270 to 306 rows improves Train-to-Dev relational generalization.
exactChangeFromV2: Accepted Train rows only: 270 -> 306. The base checkpoint, seed, optimization, loss, selector, threshold, Dev data, nine Dev gates, and final-checkpoint-only rule are unchanged.
finalPolicy: No Final Test file reads, inference, error inspection, tuning, or model-selection use.

training.checkpointRule: save and evaluate the final one-epoch checkpoint only

loss.bceReduction: mean over unmasked Product-18 cells within each row
loss.ranking: mean softplus(z_plausible - z_selected) over the within-row Cartesian product
loss.rowReduction: L_bce + lambdaRank * L_rank, then unweighted batch mean

stoppingAndSelectionRule: one epoch; final checkpoint only; KEEP_CANDIDATE only on all nine unchanged Dev gates, otherwise REJECT_CANDIDATE; no restart or rescue run
stopGoDataExpansionRule: STOP_DATA_EXPANSION unless Dev P0 raw-ranking macro improves by at least 0.030 over V2, selected-above-plausible rate improves by at least 0.030 over V2, net bad-to-good P0 ordering flips are positive, and total Dev false positives rise by no more than four over V2.
